title: Bouquet Garni
description: A classic French bundle of aromatic herbs used to infuse stocks, soups, sauces, and stews with subtle herbal flavor, then removed before serving.
instructions: Gather the bay leaf, thyme, parsley stems, and any optional herbs or vegetables.
Tie the herbs together securely with kitchen twine, or wrap them in cheesecloth and tie into a small bundle.
Add the bouquet garni to stocks, soups, sauces, braises, or stews at the beginning of cooking.
Allow it to simmer gently, releasing its aroma and flavor throughout the cooking process.
Remove and discard the bouquet garni before serving.
chefTips: Use fresh herbs whenever possible for the best aroma.
Parsley stems contain excellent flavor—don't discard them.
Customize the bouquet with herbs such as tarragon, rosemary, or savory depending on the dish.
Always remove the bouquet garni before serving.
